name: AFM level 1 task 7: Load-Dependent Average Friction
description: Acquire one contact-mode lateral-force image over a $\pu{5 µm} \times \pu{5 µm}$ area at $256 \times 256$ pixels. Use a time per line of 0.075 s, setpoint of 0.1 V, and P/I/D gains of 100/50/0. Calculate the average friction. Report all friction-signal values, in volts ($\pu{V}$) from the lateral channel.
submission_format: {"average_friction_1": "<numerical_value without units>", "path_1": "<absolute_path_to_raw_nid_image>"} e.g. {"average_friction_1": "0.12", "path_1": "/results/afm_images/image1.nid"} Return one JSON object. Example values are illustrative, not target answers. Enter numerical values without unit text, using the units specified in the question. Friction-signal values must be in V, not N.
